dhp273:1: The best of paths is the Eightfold;
dhp273:2: of truths, the one in four steps.
dhp273:3: The best of qualities is dispassion;
dhp273:4: of bipeds, the one who sees.
dhp274:1: This is the path - there is no other -
dhp275:1: When you have followed this path
dhp275:3: I have explained the path for you;
dhp275:4: by means of knowledge the sting is eased.
dhp276:1: It is by you that the effort must be made;
